name: Vlog Producer
tagline: Showruns your phone-shot vlog: plans episodes, cuts footage, cleans audio, adds subtitles.
description: Hand it the footage from a filming session and it works like a showrunner. It decides what this installment is about, structures the cut around your strongest material, then hands back a finished edit with clean sound and subtitles. Aimed at creators who shoot on a phone and want a dependable editing partner.
author: LuigiMdpDev
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
